name: numera-wiz
description: Operate the implemented Numera Wiz Rust command registry through local MCP with explicit access grants and reviewed media plans.

interface.shortDescription: Local media with Rust and MCP
interface.longDescription: Discover implemented Numera Wiz commands, inspect authorized media, review cleanup plans, submit and observe jobs, and retrieve verified artifacts. The default connection is discovery-only; an owner must configure any operating profile.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Numera Wiz to discover the available commands and current limits, then help me review and perform an authorized media workflow.
